description: A long shed of corrugated sheet, painted the colour of the rock so it barely reads as a building at all. One roller door stands high enough and wide enough to take something with a box behind it, and the concrete apron in front of it is scored with the arcs of everything that has ever backed up to it. A hand-lettered board by the door lists what is wanted and what is paid, and a second board underneath it, in the same hand, lists what will not be bought at any price.
name: Last Requisition
